name: wf-core-authoring
description: wf core-authoring pack: the core-authoring capability, carrying the knowledge for authoring the wf core plugin itself — the domain-free skill spine, the frozen contracts under the core plugin's _contracts folder, and the repository authoring rules its CI gates enforce. Declared kind: both; it ships its own skills and is authored to attach phase fragments, and its Fragments table is deliberately empty until the first contribution lands. Ships /wf-core-authoring:init for one-command self-registration of the capability.
